title: Immersive header and chrome-visible top bar used the wrong visual treatment
symptom: The reading-only header appeared as a floating pill and did not match the intended lightweight style, while the chrome-visible state lacked a clean full-width top bar with back and overflow affordances.
root_cause: The reader reused one header treatment across two different interaction states instead of modeling a lightweight immersive header and a separate full chrome top bar as distinct states.
fix: Split the reader into two explicit top-bar states: a lightweight immersive header and a full-width chrome-visible top bar.
Made the two states mutually exclusive so the immersive header disappears when the full chrome is revealed.
Reserved the right side of the full top bar for an explicit `...` placeholder.
impact: The UI looked visually inconsistent and did not match the interaction model users expect from a reading app.
